units.rhetorical_move: grant the old priority, then hang the damage over the reader
units.function: open by conceding what the system optimized, then name the two harms

original_instantiations: An opening can praise the old scoreboard and then leave two harms waiting.
The first sentence grants a goal the later plan will demote.

units.source_excerpt: food system considered the efficiency and profitability as priorities and ignored the environmental sustainability and social equity. The resulted severe environmental damage and hunger problem are hanging over our heads
units.reusable_pattern: Concede the old objective, then picture the ignored harms as already overhead.
prohibited_generalizations: do not treat the idiom as a required opening

units.rhetorical_move: name the three-letter model, then demote profit
units.function: upgrade the two new criteria by saying profit is what gets given up

original_instantiations: A named bundle can promote two criteria by spending a third.
The cost of the new ranking is stated as a sacrifice, not a footnote.

units.source_excerpt: we incorporate the Environment and Equity factors together with Economic factor to build an Environment-Equity-Economy Model (EEE Model). sustainability and equity are upgraded to priorities at the sacrifice of economic profit
units.reusable_pattern: Name a three-part model, then say which old priority is spent.
prohibited_generalizations: do not invent a sacrifice the paper did not price

units.rhetorical_move: keep a misspelled verb inside the method sentence
units.function: introduce the assistance factor with the printed spelling

original_instantiations: A method sentence can keep a misspelled measure-verb rather than silently correcting it.
The instrument is a named factor, not a fitted coefficient.

units.source_excerpt: The assistance factor is applied to mearsure the intensity of government assistance.
units.reusable_pattern: Leave the printed verb when the sentence is teaching a named factor.
reusable_elements: a coined or misspelled verb left as printed
prohibited_generalizations: do not correct mearsure into measure inside a quotation

units.rhetorical_move: deliver two country blocks with the same three cuts
units.function: close the summary on paired percentages and a misspelled obtain

original_instantiations: Two cases can share one sentence shape and differ only in the percentages.
A forecast verb can stay misspelled if that is how the line was printed.

units.source_excerpt: After simulation, we obtian the result that China will have 25.79% fewer GHG emission, 16.15% fewer eutrophication and 32.79% more spared land.
units.reusable_pattern: Pair two places in one frame: three environmental cuts, then the profit given up.
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse these percentages for another country

units.rhetorical_move: open on a cited authority, then a faulty agreement
units.function: let the subject-verb slip stand in the first claim

original_instantiations: A background can lean on an agency name and still print a broken agreement.
The positive decades come first so the severe problems can reverse them.

units.source_excerpt: According to the FAO, the nowaday food systems has yielded many positive results over the last few decades.
units.reusable_pattern: Cite an agency, grant a past success, and leave the printed agreement untouched.
prohibited_generalizations: do not smooth the agreement in a quotation

units.rhetorical_move: turn the prompt into four required jobs
units.function: list the jobs as R-marked tasks rather than as a narrative

original_instantiations: A restatement can mark each required job with the same initial.
The list is the contract, not a summary of results.

units.source_excerpt: Having understood the problem, we're required to do the following work: Develop a food system model to optimize the priority levels of efficiency, profitability, sustainability and equity.
units.reusable_pattern: After a short understanding clause, list the jobs the prompt already named.
reusable_elements: an initial repeated down the list
prohibited_generalizations: do not add a job the prompt did not ask

units.rhetorical_move: announce a figure with two misspellings
units.function: name the short form of the model in the same breath as the chart

original_instantiations: A roadmap sentence can carry two misspellings and still name the short form.
Convenience is the reason given for drawing the chart.

units.source_excerpt: For convenience, we draw a flow chart to represent our spproach. we'll adress it as EEE Model in the following paper for short.
units.reusable_pattern: Invoke convenience, then give the model the short name the rest of the paper will use.
reusable_elements: a short-name announcement with printed spelling
prohibited_generalizations: do not correct spproach or adress inside a quotation

units.rhetorical_move: preview the two countries and the later checks
units.function: end the approach by naming what the last sections will do

original_instantiations: An approach paragraph can end by naming the two places and the last three jobs.
The cases come before the talk of scale.

units.source_excerpt: Then we choose China and Finland as our target countries for case study. At last, we discuss the scalability and adaptability of our model, make a sensitivity analysis, and describe the future work.
units.reusable_pattern: Name the two cases, then list the closing jobs in the order the paper will do them.
prohibited_generalizations: do not treat the two countries as a universal pair

units.rhetorical_move: apologize for simplifying, then number the stance
units.function: pair each assumption with an arrowed justification

original_instantiations: A stance section can open by admitting it simplifies, with the verb misspelled.
Each numbered stance is followed by an arrow and a justification.

units.source_excerpt: To simiplify the problem, we make the following basic assumptions, each of which is properly justified. Assumptions 1 : We only consider calories and proteins as the basic diet need of one person.
units.reusable_pattern: Admit the simplification with the printed spelling, then number the stance and answer it after an arrow.
reusable_elements: a plural heading on a single stance
prohibited_generalizations: do not drop the arrow when quoting the pair

units.rhetorical_move: freeze the price because supply already exceeds demand
units.function: use the prompt's own claim as the justification

original_instantiations: A price can be frozen by borrowing the prompt's claim that food is already enough.
The sellers are said to be unable to move the price.

units.source_excerpt: Assumptions 2 : The price of the food is stable and constant. As the problem says, there're enough food to feed everyone in the world, thus the supply is more than the demand.
units.reusable_pattern: Tie a frozen price to the prompt's surplus, not to a new estimate.
prohibited_generalizations: do not treat a prompt sentence as a measured elasticity

units.rhetorical_move: drop transport emissions and extreme events
units.function: justify each drop by a comparison or by stability

original_instantiations: A small channel can be dropped because a cited comparison calls it much smaller.
Extreme events are set aside by calling the places regular and stable.

units.source_excerpt: Assumptions 3 : The greenhouse gas emission of food transportation can be neglected. the greenhouse gas emission of food transportation is much smaller compared to the food production. Assumptions 4 : We will ignore the influence of the extreme events.
units.reusable_pattern: Drop a channel by a size comparison, and drop shocks by calling the places stable.
prohibited_generalizations: do not drop a channel without the comparison the paper used

units.rhetorical_move: sweep the unmentioned factors, then trust the websites
units.function: close the list with a practicality premise

original_instantiations: A last stance can say unmentioned factors have little influence and call that reasonable.
Website figures are trusted because the sites are called authoritative.

units.source_excerpt: Assumptions 5 : Those factors we don't mention have few influence on the system. Assumptions 6 : The statistic we captured from website are precise and reliable.
units.reusable_pattern: End the list by limiting the factors and by trusting the sites the numbers came from.
prohibited_generalizations: do not treat few influence as a tested bound

units.rhetorical_move: introduce the table as a convenience
units.function: promise that later symbols will be defined where they are used

original_instantiations: A symbol table can be introduced as a convenience and still defer the rest.
The deferral says later symbols appear while the model is built.

units.source_excerpt: For convenience, we introduce some notations below. Other specific notations, if necessary, will be mentioned and illustrated while we're building models.
units.reusable_pattern: Open a symbol list for convenience, then defer whatever the table does not hold.
prohibited_generalizations: do not pretend the table was checked on the raster

units.rhetorical_move: say the current ranking ignores two criteria
units.function: spell equity wrong in the sentence that adds it

original_instantiations: A diagnosis can say the current ranking chases one maximum and ignores two harms.
The remedy sentence can print the new criterion with a swapped vowel.

units.source_excerpt: To optimize the food system by considering efficiency, profitability, sustainability and euqity, we establish our food system model.
units.reusable_pattern: Name the four criteria, leave the swapped vowel, then announce the model.
prohibited_generalizations: do not correct euqity inside a quotation

units.rhetorical_move: give each E its lever
units.function: tax, delivery, then a profit loss that is called the point

original_instantiations: Each part of a three-letter model can be given one lever.
The profit loss is announced as the way the old priority is removed.

units.source_excerpt: To decrease the damage of the environment, we can transform the diet composition by taxing on animal foods. We find out that there's economic profits loss, which removes the priorities from efficiency and profitability.
units.reusable_pattern: Assign one lever to each letter, and treat the profit loss as the intended demotion.
reusable_elements: a loss that removes a priority
prohibited_generalizations: do not describe the loss as an accident

units.rhetorical_move: make government the driver, and misspell it
units.function: bound the tax rate in the same sentence

features.quantitative_role: a rate on the unit interval
original_instantiations: The driver of a diet shift can be named with a missing letter.
The rate is bounded before any country number is chosen.

units.source_excerpt: Governmnet can be the driving force in this adjustment by taxing on the animal products. Denote the tax rate as T, T in [0, 1].
units.reusable_pattern: Name the driver with the printed spelling, then put the rate on the unit interval.
prohibited_generalizations: do not correct Governmnet inside a quotation

units.rhetorical_move: justify a geometric population by surplus
units.function: set the origin in the same sentence as the growth

original_instantiations: A population path can be introduced by saying food is already enough.
The origin year is stated beside the growth, not in a later note.

units.source_excerpt: Since there're enough food for human, we assume the population of a country in year t is N(t) given by N(t) = N0(1+delta)^t, and we set t = 0 in 2020.
units.reusable_pattern: Let a surplus justify a smooth population, and date the origin in the same breath.
prohibited_generalizations: do not move the origin year away from the formula

units.rhetorical_move: enlarge two shares and name the curve
units.function: give the horizon as a range of decades

original_instantiations: A shift can be described as enlarging two shares toward a vegetal-preferred state.
The horizon is a range, not a single year.

units.source_excerpt: We can enlarge mu and lambda to transform the national citizens' diet composition to vegetal-preferred state. The transformation takes time to completely accomplish and is expected to take 30-50 years.
units.reusable_pattern: Say which two shares grow, name the curve, and give the horizon as a range.
prohibited_generalizations: do not collapse 30-50 years into one deadline

units.rhetorical_move: list three effects, then promise they fall
units.function: hand the accounts to the later case

original_instantiations: Three effects can be listed before any plot, then promised to fall.
The promise is deferred to the case study.

units.source_excerpt: environmental sustainability can be achieved through three significant effects: Decrease of greenhouse gas emission, Reduction of eutrophying emission, Decline of land use. It will be shown in the following case study that three functions are decreasing with time after 2020.
units.reusable_pattern: List the three accounts, then promise the case study will show them falling.
prohibited_generalizations: do not treat the promise as the plot itself

units.rhetorical_move: set redundancy against famine
units.function: make delivery the equity action

original_instantiations: Uneven distribution can be drawn as abundance in one place and hunger in another.
The remedy is delivery, and the bill is a named tax.

units.source_excerpt: causing uneven food distribution and negative consequences, such as redundance of food in one place and famine in other place. government can collect Food Equity Tax
units.reusable_pattern: Contrast a printed redundance with famine, then name the tax that pays the delivery.
prohibited_generalizations: do not correct redundance inside a quotation

units.rhetorical_move: define assistance as a speed
units.function: say a larger factor means a shorter wait

original_instantiations: A factor can be glossed as intensity and, in the same sentence, as a shorter wait.
The gloss is qualitative before any country value.

units.source_excerpt: denoting A as Assistance Factor to measure the degree of government assistance, larger A means larger intensity of government assistance and shorter time to decrease hunger ratio.
units.reusable_pattern: Name the factor, then gloss a larger value as both more help and less waiting.
prohibited_generalizations: do not assign a number in the definition sentence

units.rhetorical_move: misspell the cost word in the setup
units.function: say the three costs are linear and the slope is a price

original_instantiations: A cost section can misspell economic in the sentence that lists the three costs.
Linearity is assumed, and the slope is called a price.

units.source_excerpt: We consider that there're three main ecnomic cost in food system, including material, land and labor. these three costs have linear relation with the amount of food production, and the slope is the price
units.reusable_pattern: List three costs under the printed spelling, then call each slope a price.
prohibited_generalizations: do not correct ecnomic inside a quotation

units.rhetorical_move: misspell current in the heading's neighbor
units.function: list benefits and then one cost

original_instantiations: A comparison section can misspell current and then sort bullets into benefits and one cost.
The profit decline is labeled a cost while the environmental moves are labeled benefits.

units.source_excerpt: 8 Difference from Currnet System. The greenhouse gas emission will decrease. (Benefit) The net economy profit of food producers and distributers will decrease to a certain limit. (Costs)
units.reusable_pattern: Keep the printed heading, tag the environmental moves as benefits, and tag the profit drop as the cost.
prohibited_generalizations: do not correct Currnet inside a quotation

units.rhetorical_move: give China a long horizon and a small coefficient
units.function: name the foods and misspell the citation and the preference

features.quantitative_role: a coefficient and two share moves
original_instantiations: A case can state a decade horizon and a coefficient before naming the foods.
The citation verb and the preference noun can both stay misspelled.

units.source_excerpt: We expect 30 years for the complete transformation to achieve, with the corresponding time coefficient r = 0.01. Accroding to the website Our World In Data and our reasonable assumptions, we determine the following constants, including the preferrence of Chinese citizens' diet.
units.reusable_pattern: State the horizon and the coefficient, then cite the site with the printed spelling.
prohibited_generalizations: do not silently replace 0.01 with the table's other figure

units.rhetorical_move: read the bars as animal above vegetal

original_instantiations: Bars can be read as one diet being much larger on every panel.
The trajectory reading names the year and one percentage, not a fitted interval.

units.source_excerpt: It is obvious to see that all parameters for animal products are much larger than parameters for vegetal products. Total GHG emission per year will decrease 25.79% in 2050.
units.reusable_pattern: Read the comparison as obvious, then give the year and the single percentage.
prohibited_generalizations: do not invent bar heights the crop did not settle

units.rhetorical_move: set China's assistance and tax, then the two dates
units.function: call the profit cut a reasonable sacrifice, and misspell the intervention

features.quantitative_role: two rates, two dates, one percentage
original_instantiations: A case can set two small rates and then name the year the insecure count hits zero.
The profit cut is defended as a reasonable sacrifice, not apologized for.

units.source_excerpt: we set the assistance factor A = 0.01, and the Animals Products Tax T = 0.05. government can make inverventions. by 2029 there's no food insecure people in China. Wnet(t) shall decrease 5.14% per year. it's reasonable sacrifice for sustainable development.
units.reusable_pattern: Set the two rates, keep the misspelled intervention, date the zero, and call the cut reasonable.
prohibited_generalizations: do not read per year as a proved annual rate

units.rhetorical_move: gather the China cuts into one table
units.function: repeat the priority-removal line as the modification row

original_instantiations: A case can close by putting the same cuts into a table.
The modification row repeats the demotion of the old priorities.

units.source_excerpt: To summarize the effects of our re-optimizing food system, we list all the consequences in Table 3. Remove the priorities from efficiency and profitability.
units.reusable_pattern: Pivot with to summarize, then let the table's first row restate the demotion.
prohibited_generalizations: do not add a row the table did not print

units.rhetorical_move: give Finland the faster coefficient
units.function: contrast the developed starting diet with China's

original_instantiations: The second case can be faster because the starting diet is more animal.
The coefficient is an order larger than the first case's prose value.

units.source_excerpt: Finland will have 33.22% fewer GHG emission. with the corresponding time coefficient r = 0.2.
units.reusable_pattern: Give the second place a larger coefficient and a larger greenhouse-gas cut.
prohibited_generalizations: do not swap the two countries' coefficients

units.rhetorical_move: set Finland's larger assistance and tax
units.function: date the zero at the middle of a year and price the cut

features.quantitative_role: two larger rates and one percentage
original_instantiations: The second case can use larger rates and a mid-year zero.
The profit cut is again called a reasonable sacrifice.

units.source_excerpt: we set the assistance factor A = 0.2, and the Animals Products Tax T = 0.1. by the middle of 2027 there's no food insecure people in Finland. Wnet(t) shall decrease 9.77% per year.
units.reusable_pattern: Raise both rates, date the zero to the middle of a year, and repeat the sacrifice frame.
prohibited_generalizations: do not move Finland's zero onto China's year

units.rhetorical_move: compare the two populations and call the ratio 250
units.function: limit the claim to country scale

features.quantitative_role: two populations and a round ratio
original_instantiations: Scale can be argued by pairing a very large population with a small one.
The same paragraph then refuses villages and continents.

units.source_excerpt: China, has the largest population on the world (1.4billion). Finland, has 5.5million population, which means the food system of Finland is 250 times smaller than Chinese food system. our model is limited in the food system much smaller than country like villages.
units.reusable_pattern: Pair the two populations, give a round ratio, then fence the claim at country scale.

units.rhetorical_move: fence the model at the very poor and the very rich
units.function: misspell highly, and list rich countries

original_instantiations: A model can be fenced where animal food is already absent and where hunger is already rare.

units.source_excerpt: in extremely poor regions almost dont consume animal products, the environmental aspect of our model cant work well. In some highly developed countries, like Norway, Singapore, Sweden Luxembourg, there are few hungry people. limited to some extremely poor and extremely rich area. these hilghly developed regions.
units.reusable_pattern: Fence both tails, leave the misspelled adverb, and name the rich examples.
prohibited_generalizations: do not correct hilghly inside a quotation

units.rhetorical_move: perturb the food weights and call the change slight
units.function: read stable curves as robustness

original_instantiations: A check can move diet weights and report only that the change is slight.
Stable curves are then called robustness, without a numeric band.

units.source_excerpt: We change the weights of specific foods in vegetal food and animal food, i.e. alpha and beta. The following changes of environmental parameters are slight. the overall tendency of the curve stays stable, which suggests the robustness of our model.
units.reusable_pattern: Move the weights, call the shift slight, and read a stable curve as robustness.
prohibited_generalizations: do not invent a percentage band the section did not print

units.rhetorical_move: point at the two sensitivity figures
units.function: let the figures carry the country split

original_instantiations: A check can end by pointing at one figure per country.

units.source_excerpt: We plot of our result of sensitivity analysis of cases in China and Finland. Figure 9 and Figure 10.
units.reusable_pattern: Point at one sensitivity figure per country and leave the numbers in the figure.

units.rhetorical_move: mark strengths with a P and keep the misspellings

units.source_excerpt: P Our sensitivity analyses show that our models are fairly robust. P making our model conprehensive and objective. P significant progress on four indicators(GHG eimission, eutrophication, land use, hunger rario)

units.rhetorical_move: reuse the large-and-small claim as a strength

units.source_excerpt: Our model works well on both large and small food systems, which means that our model is adaptable.

units.rhetorical_move: mark limits with a C

units.source_excerpt: C Some of the parameters are baesd on semi-educated guess because there're some data are unavaliable. C We only consider the calories and proteins as the main nutritions.
units.reusable_pattern: Mark the limit with C, keep the printed spellings, and own the two-nutrient cut.
prohibited_generalizations: do not correct baesd or unavaliable inside a quotation

units.rhetorical_move: say the benefit will not last, and misspell long-term
units.function: offer soilless culture as a later plan that is still too costly

The next plan is named and then called too costly to spread yet.

But we believe that with the development of agricultural technology, these environmentally friendly but economically unfriendly agricultural production pattern will one day be globally extended.

prohibited_generalizations: do not correct long-trem inside a quotation

units.rhetorical_move: number the sources and misspell website
units.function: mix an agency booklet with three site pages

original_instantiations: A source list can number an agency booklet beside several pages of one site.

units.source_excerpt: References. The page about environmental impacts of food in wedsite Our World in Data.
units.reusable_pattern: Number each source, and leave wedsite as printed.
prohibited_generalizations: the list is this paper's own and should not be copied as a template
